mentions.name: Questly
mentions.description: AI simulation platform for practicing difficult real-world conversations such as negotiations, feedback, and conflict, functioning like a flight simulator for conversations people usually avoid.
mentions.problem: People mentally prepare for difficult conversations but freeze in the actual moment.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Questly (https://questly.academy/) — an AI simulation platform for practicing difficult real-world conversations (negotiations, feedback, conflict). Think flight simulator, but for conversations people usually avoid.
